redFirst.basis: `node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs --check` in a throwaway tree at HEAD: inline suite tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (its test file is its implementation file): it is not Python, and an inline suite's test hunks are read from Python definitions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: tools/capture-screenshots.mjs only. Added exported PINNED_CONTEXT {locale en-US, timezoneId UTC, numberSample '1,234,567.5'} and pure exported pinProblem(facts); pageContextFacts reads Intl locale, navigator.language, Intl timezone and (1234567.5).toLocaleString() from the live page; shot() calls pinProblem before the --check return (so every shutter asks, in --check too); assertPinDetectorRejects(browser) runs first in main()'s try and opens a deliberate de-DE/Asia/Tokyo context, failing the run if pinProblem does not reject it (the control is not an unpinned context, since on an en-US/UTC host that is indistinguishable). All 9 browser.newContext sites for captures now carry locale: PIN_LOCALE, timezoneId: PIN_TIMEZONE; chromium.launch also gets --lang=en-US. Header comment of --check updated. Probes (Playwright, this macOS host, AppleLocale en_US@rg=rszzzz, tz Europe/Belgrade): context locale/timezoneId reach Intl, navigator.language, Date and toLocaleString. BUT the native <input type=date> placeholder ('dd. mm. yyyy.') did NOT move under: context locale (en-US,en,en-GB,en-CA,en-AU,fr-FR,ja-JP,de-DE,sr-RS all identical), element lang, --lang=en-US/en-GB/en, env LANG/LC_ALL/LANGUAGE, CFFIXED_USER_HOME with a planted .GlobalPreferences; only --lang=de-DE / fr-FR changed it. Playwright also refuses '-AppleLocale en_US' launch args ('Arguments can not specify page to be opened'). Gates: --check exit 0 (green run emitted the control note); full sweep 335/335 files ok exit 0; npx vitest run 56 files / 830 tests passed. Falsifier verified by hand in a throwaway copy tools/.fals-tmp.mjs (removed): replacing the control context's de-DE/Asia/Tokyo with en-US/UTC under --check --only report exited 1 with 'context pin: a de-DE / Asia/Tokyo context passed pinProblem'. Requirement clauses: (a) set locale/timezone: done at the 9 newContext sites (grep -n 'locale: PIN_LOCALE' tools/capture-screenshots.mjs); asserted before shutter: done in shot(); unpinned fails the check: done (red above). (b) 'report's date inputs render the host placeholder in committed shots': NOT fixed, because no lever was found for the native control on macOS with a regional-format override; documented in PINNED_CONTEXT's doc comment, so committed shots of those inputs remain host-shaped on such a host. No PNGs were regenerated (capture is the orchestrator's browser step).
outcome.descriptive: Capture contexts now run en-US/UTC and every shutter asserts it, with a negative control; the native date-input placeholder remains host-shaped on macOS regional overrides, documented not fixed.
